subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: After the P2/P3 source findings are fixed, should maintainers accept this exact-head retirement of `qa-matrix` together with the reusable Matrix QA workflow secret boundary and additive QA runner adapter contract?
rationale: The remaining non-mechanical gates change dependency ownership, release proof automation, secret-bearing workflow behavior, and plugin SDK API shape, which require owner intent rather than only source correctness.

options.title: Fix findings and approve exact head
options.body: Restore the mock provider default, fix AGENTS formatting, then have authorized dependency/workflow owners approve the exact package graph, secret boundary, and SDK surface before merge.

options.title: Split workflow and SDK churn
options.body: Land only the package/runtime retirement after fixing findings, and move reusable workflow routing or QA runner API changes into smaller owner-reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Pause the retirement
options.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainers are ready to own dependency graph deletion and release QA workflow changes together.

recommendation.title: Fix findings and approve exact head
recommendation.body: Restore the mock provider default, fix AGENTS formatting, then have authorized dependency/workflow owners approve the exact package graph, secret boundary, and SDK surface before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workflow/package-boundary history makes this the best available owner for dependency graph and reusable workflow approval.
